**8B.1 Assessment: yes, but mixed and increasingly politicized**

Jokowi’s 2024 record does show a legible governing program: developmentalism, infrastructure, Nusantara, investment attraction, social protection, and technocratic macro management. That program is clear enough to evaluate against later action. The weaker point is that, in 2024, the same program increasingly sat alongside succession management, patronage, and family-advantage politics.

**Evidence**
| Direction | Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Positive | `Indonesia election: Joko Widodo` | AP News | 2024-02-11 | https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-election-joko-widodo-7a47cf5e0811bedb95914b4ba20199bf | AP describes Jokowi’s final year as centered on strong growth, major infrastructure delivery, and a controversial capital-relocation project, which shows a coherent development-and-state-building program. | 8B.1 |
| Positive | `Presiden Jokowi Resmikan Plaza Seremoni Sumbu Kebangsaan di Ibu Kota Nusantara` | Presidential Secretariat of the Republic of Indonesia | 2024-08-14 | https://presidenri.go.id/siaran-pers/presiden-jokowi-resmikan-plaza-seremoni-sumbu-kebangsaan-di-ibu-kota-nusantara/ | Jokowi publicly advanced Nusantara as tangible progress, showing the flagship capital project remained a central, explicit strategic goal. | 8B.1 |
| Positive | `Indonesia's climate ambitions gain boost through World Bank-supported land administration and spatial planning reform` | World Bank | 2024-09-30 | https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/09/30/indonesia-s-climate-ambitions-gain-boost-through-world-bank-supported-land-administration-and-spatial-planning-reform | The reform agenda was framed around land tenure security, simpler licensing, better spatial planning, and reduced disputes, which is a concrete policy program rather than vague rhetoric. | 8B.1 |
| Positive | `Indonesia is growing at about 5 percent, poverty fell from 17.5 percent in 2023 to 15.8 percent in 2024` | World Bank | 2024-10-02 | https://documents.worldbank.org/en/publication/documents-reports/documentdetail/099026110152411280 | The World Bank’s framing reinforces that the administration’s strategic direction was pro-growth and welfare-improving, with measurable targets in poverty and growth. | 8B.1 |
| Positive | `Indonesia economy projected to remain resilient` | World Bank | 2024-06-24 | https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/06/24/indonesia-economy-projected-to-remain-resilient | The World Bank credited Indonesia’s robust macro framework and policy credibility, supporting the reading that Jokowi’s economic direction was technocratic and state-capacity oriented. | 8B.1 |
| Positive | `Pr24221 IMF staff completes 2024 Article IV Mission to Indonesia` | IMF | 2024-06-14 | https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/06/14/pr24221-imf-staff-completes-2024-article-iv-mission-to-indonesia | IMF described prudent, credible, shock-ready fiscal and monetary frameworks, indicating a coherent macro strategy rather than ad hoc management. | 8B.1 |
| Positive | `JKN / Mobile JKN` | World Health Organization | 2024-12-06 | https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789240100893 | WHO says JKN was designed to expand access and financial protection, while Mobile JKN simplified enrollment and payments, showing a defined social-policy program with implementation goals. | 8B.1 |
| Positive | `Indonesia launches golden visa to lure foreign investors, boost economy` | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-07-25 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/indonesia-launches-golden-visa-to-lure-foreign-investors-boost-economy-3535351 | The golden visa shows a deliberate investment-attraction strategy, consistent with a coherent pro-growth and pro-capital policy line. | 8B.1 |
| Negative | `Jokowi seeks Golkar takeover to retain decade-long influence` | Reuters via The Jakarta Post | 2024-03-20 | https://www.thejakartapost.com/indonesia/2024/03/20/jokowi-seeks-golkar-takeover-to-retain-decade-long-influence | Reuters reported Jokowi trying to install a loyal ally at Golkar and preserve influence after office, revealing a goal of post-office political control. | 8B.1, 7B.9 |
| Negative | `Indonesia leader accused of bias, interference in presidential election` | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-02-01 | https://theprint.in/world/indonesia-leader-accused-of-bias-interference-in-presidential-election/1948656/ | Criticism of visible alignment with Prabowo while his son was on the ticket suggests the governing project was also about shaping succession, not just policy. | 8B.1, 7B.8, 7B.10 |
| Negative | `Protests across Indonesia as parliament delays change to election law` | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-08-22 | https://theprint.in/world/protests-across-indonesia-as-parliament-delays-change-to-election-law/2233305/ | The rule changes were widely seen as helping Jokowi’s youngest son and consolidating family advantage, which exposes regime-control motives inside the broader governing program. | 8B.1, 7B.8, 7B.9, 7B.10 |
| Negative | `Outgoing Indonesian president gives cabinet jobs to loyalists of successor Prabowo` | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-08-19 | https://theprint.in/world/outgoing-indonesian-president-gives-cabinet-jobs-to-loyalists-of-successor-prabowo/2228867/ | The cabinet reshuffle was framed as transition-smoothing but was heavily loyalty-based, showing that politics and succession management were part of the operating strategy. | 8B.1, 7B.9 |
| Negative | `Analysis: A decade of Jokowi, Indonesia’s democracy icon, leaves illiberal legacy, critics say` | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-10-14 | https://theprint.in/world/analysis-a-decade-of-jokowi-indonesias-democracy-icon-leaves-illiberal-legacy-critics-say/2310394/ | Reuters’ end-of-term analysis ties the decade together as strong development plus patronage, dynastic politics, and weaker institutional integrity, which is the clearest high-level evaluation of the gap between stated direction and political practice. | 8B.1, 7B.8, 7B.9, 7B.10 |
| Mixed | `Jokowi formally transferred power to Prabowo` | Sekretariat Kabinet Republik Indonesia | 2024-10-20 | https://setkab.go.id/en/farewell-welcome-ceremony-for-indonesias-president-from-jokowi-to-prabowo-subianto/ | The formal handover shows he still operated within constitutional succession rules, so the regime-control story was not absolute. | 8B.1, 7B.8 |
| Mixed | `Jokowi publicly apologized for mistakes and shortcomings in office` | Presidency of Indonesia | 2024-08-01 | https://presidenri.go.id/siaran-pers/presiden-jokowi-saya-tidak-sempurna-saya-manusia-biasa/ | Public apology suggests some willingness to frame his tenure as a governable program with admitted error, not pure infallibility or permanent personal rule. | 8B.1, 7B.10 |

**Bottom line**
- There is a clear, evaluable governing program in 2024: development, infrastructure, Nusantara, growth, investment, social protection, and state-capacity upgrading.
- That program is not hidden or merely inferred; it is visible in official speeches and policy choices.
- The main limitation is that by 2024 the program was also serving succession and family-preservation politics, so the ideology looks less like a pure doctrine and more like a developmental program fused with power maintenance.

**Search gap**
- I did not find a single 2024 manifesto or doctrine document that neatly states Jokowi’s full ideology in one place.
- The clearest picture comes from repeated official actions and speeches, which are enough to infer a coherent direction, but not a tightly codified ideology.
